_help: Act 9, the burial chamber: whoever of Noura and Omar is alive begins the rite (ritual_voices 2 or 1; act9.gd makes it slower with one) and event ritual_defence starts the last fight (end_defend). With neither alive: ritual_failed (end_failed). After the defence, act9_end. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

both.speaker: noura
both.line: Omar, the far end. The jars in their niches, the eye in its cradle. Hold them off for as long as it takes. Two voices, quickly.

noura_alone.speaker: noura
noura_alone.line: Omar is gone, so I sing both parts. It will take longer. Hold them. Hold them!

omar_alone.speaker: omar
omar_alone.line: She taught me both parts. I never thought I would need them. Hold them off, foreigner. For her.

nobody.speaker: player
nobody.line: Nobody left who knows the words. The jars, the eye, the cradle, and no voice to bind them.

go.speaker: player
go.line: The first notes of the chant, and every dead thing in Akmentar turns toward the burial chamber.
